{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "请列出最近30天内发生过'七天无理由'退款的商品名称、品牌和类别，按商品名称升序排列，最多显示100条。",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "entity_filter",
      "intended_meaning": "查询在2026-08-14至2026-09-12期间，退款原因为'七天无理由'且状态为approved的退款所关联的商品（通过refunds→order_items→products链路），返回其product_name、brand、category三列，去重后按product_name ASC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "七天无理由",
      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确指定了时间范围（最近30天）、退款状态隐含为approved（业务合同定义refund_amount仅对approved统计），但'七天无理由'作为refund_reason值未在question中字面写出，而是以中文描述形式出现，需用户确认该字符串是否严格匹配数据库中refunds.refund_reason字段的精确值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["七天无理由", "7天无理由"],
      "semantic_signature": "refunds.refund_reason:filter_approved_exact_match_product_name_brand_category_order_by_product_name_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, p.brand, p.category FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_reason = '七天无理由' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' ORDER BY p.product_name ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出2026年8月销售过的所有'家用电器'类商品的名称、品牌和上市日期，按上市日期降序排列，最多显示100条。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "entity_filter",
      "intended_meaning": "查询在2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间有有效订单（orders.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）的商品中，属于'家用电器'类别的产品，返回product_name、brand、launch_date，去重后按launch_date DESC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "家用电器",
      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确给出时间（2026年8月）、订单有效性条件（销售过即隐含valid orders）、排序与行数限制，但'家用电器'作为products.category字段的取值未在question中显式声明为筛选条件字面量，需用户确认该字符串是否为category列的精确匹配值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["家用电器", "大家电"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_sales_in_aug2026_product_name_brand_launch_date_order_by_launch_date_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, p.brand, p.launch_date FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND p.category = '家用电器' ORDER BY p.launch_date DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出截至2026年9月12日，所有已上架且从未产生过任何订单的'手机数码'类商品的名称、品牌和列表价格，按列表价格升序排列，最多显示100条。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "entity_filter",
      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中is_active=1且category='手机数码'，且其product_id未出现在任何order_items记录中的商品，返回product_name、brand、list_price，按list_price ASC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "手机数码",
      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确给出截止日期、状态（已上架=is_active=1）、行为定义（从未产生订单=product_id not in order_items），但'手机数码'作为category维度值未以字面量形式写入问题，需用户确认该字符串是否为products.category列的精确值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["手机数码", "数码产品"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_active_never_ordered_product_name_brand_list_price_order_by_list_price_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.product_name, p.brand, p.list_price FROM products p WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND p.category = '手机数码' AND p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items) ORDER BY p.list_price ASC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出2026年9月11日当天完成支付的订单中，涉及'服饰鞋包'类商品的订单编号、商品名称和购买数量，按购买数量降序排列，最多显示100条。",

      "intended_meaning": "查询orders.order_date='2026-09-11'且order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')的订单，与其order_items及products关联后，筛选category='服饰鞋包'的商品行，返回order_no、product_name、quantity，按quantity DESC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "服饰鞋包",
      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确指定日期（2026-09-11）、订单状态（完成支付即valid orders）、输出列与排序，但'服饰鞋包'作为products.category字段的筛选值未在question中直接写出，需用户确认该字符串是否为精确匹配值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["服饰鞋包", "服装鞋帽"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_orders_on_20260911_valid_order_no_product_name_quantity_order_by_quantity_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT o.order_no, p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date = '2026-09-11' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '服饰鞋包' ORDER BY oi.quantity DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "请列出所有'云栖'品牌的'美妆个护'类商品中，在2026年9月1日至12日期间产生过退款的商品名称、上市日期和当前是否上架状态，按上市日期升序排列，最多显示100条。",
      "category": "product",

      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中brand='云栖'且category='美妆个护'，且其product_id在refunds表中对应refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12'且refund_status='approved'的记录，返回product_name、launch_date、is_active，去重后按launch_date ASC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "美妆个护",

    {

      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "entity_filter",
      "intended_meaning": "查询orders.order_date='2026-09-12'的有效订单所关联的order_items及products中，category='母婴用品'的商品，返回product_name、brand、cost_price，去重后按cost_price DESC LIMIT 100。",
      "simulated_answer": "母婴用品",

      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["母婴用品", "孕婴童"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_orders_on_20260912_product_name_brand_cost_price_order_by_cost_price_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, p.brand, p.cost_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date = '2026-09-12' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '母婴用品' ORDER BY p.cost_price DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true

    {
      "question": "请列出所有'优选'品牌下'运动户外'类商品中，在2026年8月有销售记录且平均单价超过200元的商品名称、品牌、类别和平均单价，按平均单价降序排列，最多显示100条。",
      "category": "product",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "entity_filter",
      "intended_meaning": "查询products表中brand='优选'且category='运动户外'，且其product_id在2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间的order_items中存在记录，且AVG(unit_price) > 200的商品，返回product_name、brand、category、avg_unit_price，按avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 100。",

      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中已指定品牌（优选）、时间（2026年8月）、数值条件（平均单价>200）、聚合与排序，但'运动户外'作为category字段值未在question中显式写出，需用户确认该字符串是否为products.category列的精确值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["运动户外", "户外运动"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_youxuan_sales_aug2026_avg_unit_price_gt200_product_name_brand_category_avg_unit_price_order_by_avg_unit_price_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.product_name, p.brand, p.category, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.brand = '优选' AND p.category = '运动户外' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category HAVING AVG(oi.unit_price) > 200 ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 100;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {

      "answer_slot": "entity",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中明确日期（2026-09-11）、订单状态（发货）、城市（南京市）、输出列与排序，但'食品生鲜'作为products.category字段的筛选值未以字面量形式出现，需用户确认该字符串是否为精确匹配值。",
      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["食品生鲜", "生鲜食品"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_shipped_nanjing_foods_order_no_user_name_product_name_quantity_order_by_quantity_asc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT o.order_no, u.user_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date = '2026-09-11' AND o.order_status = 'shipped' AND u.city = '南京市' AND p.category = '食品生鲜' ORDER BY oi.quantity ASC LIMIT 100;",

      "simulated_answer": "家用电器",

      "ambiguity_alternatives": ["家用电器", "厨房电器"],
      "semantic_signature": "products.category:filter_beichen_refunded_misdescription_in_sep1to12_product_name_brand_category_refund_amount_order_by_refund_amount_desc_limit100",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.product_name, p.brand, p.category, r.refund_amount FROM products p JOIN refunds r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand = '北辰' AND p.category = '家用电器' AND r.refund_reason = '七天无理由' AND r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;",

      "ambiguity_explanation": "问题中已指定日期（2026-09-12）、订单状态（支付行为即valid orders）、城市（成都市）、品牌（松果）、输出列与排序，但'美妆个护'作为products.category字段的筛选值未在question中字面写出，需用户确认该字符串是否为精确匹配值。",
